messages:
Sam (Product Designer): Morning — Sam here, first day on onboarding UX. Need the shortest path to: Figma access, canonical onboarding component library, roadmap link, and where research synths + highlight clips are. 
Ivy (DesignOps): Welcome Sam! :tada: Which email did you sign up with? I can send invites and the "new-designer skim" list. 
Sam (Product Designer): sam@redwood.com. Also, is there a preferred Figma file to fork for experiments? 
Maya (Design System): Sent DS library invite. Canonical library: Team > Redwood DS > Components > Onboarding. For experiments fork the sprint prototype ("Onboarding — Sprint X") not the library. Accept the library to get tokens. 
Diego_IT: Okta should've provisioned your account. If Figma invite doesn't show: go to https://okta.redwood.com/apps -> Request Access -> Figma or run `/request-app figma sam@redwood.com` in Slack. DM me if it hangs. 
Rae (Research): Research stuff: raw sessions + clips in Dovetail (project: onboarding_tests). Synths and TL;DR cards are in Notion under Research > Syntheses > Onboarding. We prefer a 2-sentence TL;DR + 3 action bullets. 
Luca (PM): Roadmap is in Notion (Product > Roadmap > Onboarding initiative). Quick offer: 15m sync today 2pm if you want context. 
Sam (Product Designer): Got Figma invite and joined the DS team, accepted library. Thanks! Booking the 2pm. 
Ivy (DesignOps): Pro-tips: 1) Accept DS library first, 2) skim "Activation funnel" + latest usability TL;DR, 3) join #design-review and the crits calendar. 
welcome-bot: Automated: added Sam (Product Designer) to "Design" Figma org and granted Notion read access (pending acceptance). 
Sam (Product Designer): All set — accepted library and skimmed the TL;DR. I'll drop my prototype into the crit agenda before 2pm. Appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:
